{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Define 'actually completed' as 'status == completed' AND 'revenue > 0'
actual_completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Count the number of such orders
count_actual_completed = len(actual_completed_orders)

# Verify the count
count_actual_completed"}
